title: Medicinal Pill
body:
Syntax: craft pill medicine <level>  |  examine <pill>  |  use <pill>  |  eat <pill>

Description: Bukijutsu level 25+ crafts one pill from Medicinal Herbs. Choose a level from 1 to your own level; it is saved in item data and shown by examine, not in the name. Using it restores Health, Chakra, and Stamina by 100 + six times its level, each over 30 seconds. It does not cure status effects. Use 'eat 2.pill' or 'use 2.pill' to select the second matching pill.

Date: 2026-09-27
